note: The IEOM's observatory of bank charges in the French Pacific (prices at 1 April 2026), French Polynesia's table: the yearly price, in CFP francs, of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept.
